findings.title: Vitest UI Server arbitrary file read (CVE CVSS 9.8, dev-only)
findings.description: Vitest direct devDependency has critical CVE when UI server is listening. Requires explicitly running vitest --ui, dev-only.
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker on same network as dev running vitest --ui could read arbitrary files via path traversal.
findings.impact: File disclosure on developer workstation during local dev.
findings.recommendation: Update vitest to patched version, or disallow UI server bind to 0.0.0.0.

findings.title: js-yaml merge-key chain DoS (CVE CVSS 7.5, direct dependency)
findings.description: js-yaml@4.2.0 has quadratic CPU consumption via YAML merge-key chains. Used to parse architecture.yaml, specification.yaml etc.
findings.exploit_scenario: Maliciously crafted YAML with deep merge-key chains causes CPU exhaustion during xp-gate architecture validation.
findings.impact: DoS via crafted YAML input during git hooks.
